items.raw_excerpt: Taiwanese roller skaters Chuang Wei-ning (莊惟甯) and Liu Yi-hsuan (劉懿萱) won gold and silver, respectively, in their 500+D sprint events at the 2026 World Skate Games in Asunción, Paraguay, on Monday (local time).

items.raw_excerpt: An Indonesian official described the forest fires causing haze across Malaysia and Singapore as a natural phenomenon, claiming that Indonesia's forests also supply oxygen to its neighbors.

items.raw_excerpt: Strong winds and thunderstorms were forecast for southern Italy on Tuesday, before an advancing high-pressure system brings stability and a rise in temperatures.

items.raw_excerpt: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

items.raw_excerpt: Coral reefs are facing increasing threats around the globe. But on a remote Pacific island, scientists have found that reefs can get help from a surprising ally: seabirds.
items.summary_en: Scientists say seabirds can help coral reefs on a remote Pacific island. The birds drop nutrients into the water, which helps the reefs grow. Researchers hope the idea can protect reefs elsewhere too.

items.raw_excerpt: Two Dutch privacy organisations are seeking an injunction against Meta to ban sales of the company’s AI glasses in the Netherlands. Offlimits and The Firewall argue that the devices, which allow users to film and record scenes that they are viewing through the lenses, breach Dutch criminal laws that protect people from being photographed and filmed without their consent. Lawyers wrote to Meta two weeks ago demanding they withdraw the glasses from sale in the Netherlands or face legal action,...
items.summary_en: Two Dutch privacy groups want a court to ban the sale of Meta's AI glasses in the Netherlands. They say the glasses can film and record what users see, breaking laws against filming people without consent. Their lawyers sent Meta a letter two weeks ago demanding the glasses be pulled from sale.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드의 두 프라이버시 단체가 메타의 AI 안경 판매를 금지해달라며 법원에 요청을 준비하고 있다. 이들은 안경이 사용자가 보는 장면을 촬영하고 녹음할 수 있어, 동의 없는 촬영을 막는 네덜란드 법을 어긴다고 주장한다. 이들 단체는 2주 전 메타에 안경 판매 중단을 요구하는 서한을 보냈다.
items.title_en: Privacy campaigners ask court to ban Meta AI glasses
items.title_ko: 프라이버시 단체, 메타 AI 안경 판매 금지 법원에 요청
items.title_original: Privacy campaigners to ask court to ban sale of Meta AI glasses

items.raw_excerpt: Ramlila Maidan now a restricted protest site with only three December dates available, costing ₹50,000 daily plus deposit.
items.summary_en: Delhi has named Ramlila Maidan as its new official protest site. The ground is booked until the end of 2026, with only three dates left in December. Groups must pay 50,000 rupees a day plus a deposit.
